# chronosphere_circleci_external_connection (Resource)

CircleCI API token that a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` with `provider_type = "circleci"` references through `external_connection_slug` to collect CircleCI metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "circleci_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "chronosphere_circleci_external_connection" "circleci" {
  name      = "CircleCI"
  api_token = var.circleci_api_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) CircleCI personal API token, or an OAuth token at Read level, used to read the projects the cloud integration lists. The API never returns the token, so a token changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported connection plans one update to set it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the external connection.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the connection. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation, so changing it replaces the connection. If a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` uses the connection, the replacement needs `create_before_destroy` and a new `name` in the same apply, because a connection in use cannot be deleted and names are unique.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
